title: Seven Ways to Save on API Costs
excerpt: Seven concrete tactics that reduce your bill without hurting quality.

content.p: Use the smallest model that still gives good results. Most apps over-pay because they use a top model for trivial tasks.

content.caption: Small changes add up on your bill

content.p: Every token in the system prompt is billed on every request. Keep instructions tight.
Cap max_tokens so the model never rambles past what you need.
Repeat questions get cached answers. Idempotent endpoints save a lot over a month.
Send multiple items in one request and ask for JSON output in one pass.
Hard limits prevent surprise spikes from tests, cron jobs or leaked keys.
Apply these and most teams cut their bill by 30-50% 💙.

faq.q: Which tactic gives the biggest saving?
faq.a: Right-sizing the model. Most teams over-pay because they use a top model for simple tasks.
No. Answers served from cache do not consume tokens.

faq.q: Can I set a monthly budget?
faq.a: Set quotas per token today; automatic monthly budgets are coming soon.
Usually not for structured tasks like classification and extraction.
